sentences.text:
And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Raman Mishra,Himanshu Chaubey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.

The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime/FIR No. 358/2013, under Sections 498A/306 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S.
Huzoorpur, District Bahraich.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
She has no role in commission of the offence.
It has been further submitted that the applicant undertakes to cooperate in the trial.

Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Smt. Asha Singh @ Asha Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Asha Singh @ Asha Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Perusal of the record shows that cognizance in the case was taken on 14.09.2014; non-bailable warrants have been issued against the applicant on 30.01.2014 and since then she is absconding; in the prosecution case, there are serious allegations against the applicant of demand of dowry,
committing cruelty and instigating the deceased to commit suicide.
Considering the conduct of the applicant as well as gravity of the offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application of the applicant is dismissed.
